stories.title: Ohtani to play at less than 100% in playoffs: Will need to 'manage' injuries
stories.summary: Dodgers star Shohei Ohtani said the left knee and right bicep ailments that compromised him throughout the summer are issues he's "just going to have to manage" in the postseason.

stories.title: 49ers owner York suspended 6 games, fined $500K for personal conduct violation
stories.summary: 49ers owner Jed York has been suspended for six games and fined $500,000 for violating the NFL's personal conduct policy stemming from his August arrest after he tried to engage in prostitution in Ohio.

stories.title: Tyler Adams named USMNT captain for new World Cup cycle
stories.summary: Tyler Adams will be the new captain of the United States men's national team, coach Mauricio Pochettino announced Friday.

stories.title: Tony Reno, who guided Yale to 5 Ivy League football titles, dies at 52
stories.summary: Former Yale football coach Tony Reno, who stepped down after the 2025 season due to health issues, has died at the age of 52, the university announced.

stories.title: Rams DT Donald out, WR Nacua returns against Eagles
stories.summary: Rams defensive tackle Aaron Donald will not play against the Eagles as he deals with back soreness, while wide receiver Puka Nacua will return from a hip injury after missing the past two games.
